remarks: Beautifully updated and tastefully appointed open-concept ranch in the highly desirable Silvermine neighborhood, conveniently located near the town centers of Wilton and New Canaan, Gray Barns, top-rated schools, train stations, and major highways. This exceptional home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 full and 2 half baths, with a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite features a walk-in closet and a luxurious spa-like bath, while two additional bedrooms include one with an en-suite bath. The heart of the home is the expansive kitchen with a large center island, seamlessly flowing into the dining area, family room, and inviting living room with fireplace. A mudroom, laundry area, playroom, and powder room complete the main level. Step outside to enjoy your private backyard retreat featuring a deck, patio, and in-ground pool, perfect for relaxing or hosting guests. A two-car garage provides added convenience and storage. Combining modern updates, timeless style, and an unbeatable location, this move-in-ready home offers the perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and accessibility.
